head: Field
Meaning
sheets.name: notes
rows: All three levels in one table; filter on 'schymanski_level'. One compound = ONE row, at its best level (L1 > L2a > L3).
Synthetic test campaign (fixture, not real data): Fictional Orbitrap, DDA fictional HCD, DDA POS+NEG, sorbents OA + EC.
SiteA (Site A), SiteB (Site B). A sample is a site; the sorbents are two extractions of the same water (areas summed).
by_identity = identities from identity_table() (the count of the paper). features = one row per feature/ion.

Reference standard: mass <= 5.0 ppm, RT within 0.35 min of the standard on this instrument, and MS/MS cosine ≥ 0.7 on ≥ 2 fragments against the standard's own spectrum of the same ion (or confirmed by the chemist in level1_decisions.csv). confidence_score = that MS/MS cosine.
Spectral-library match: cosine ≥ 0.70 with ≥ 4 shared fragment ions and the library precursor within 15 ppm (otherwise an analogue). confidence_score = best cosine.

CSI:FingerID structure with COSMIC (ConfidenceScoreApproximate) ≥ 0.64, ~10% FDR (Hoffmann et al., Nat. Biotechnol. 2022) -- confidence_score = COSMIC; or a reference standard matching mass + RT whose MS/MS could not confirm it (see why_level).

direct = library hit on the SAME precursor (|ppm| <= 20) -> true L2a; analog = similar spectrum of a DIFFERENT mass (GNPS analogue search): not the same molecule; mzMine (no ppm) = mzMine hit, no error reported.
Analogue hits only: reading of the mass difference (homologue, transformation, artifact, near-isobaric, unassigned). Always putative.
Shared MS2 peaks and precursor error of the best library hit (GNPS2; SIRIUS for the peaks). mzMine does not report them.
RT vs logP consistency relative to the other L3 candidates of the batch (isotonic fit, robust z). |z| > 3.5 = outlier: a clue, not a proof, of a wrong structure.
Sum of the areas of all collapsed features (all sorbents), DETECTED only. Semi-quantitative proxy.
Non-contaminants: a library name does not prove a natural origin (the key 'natural' is a name heuristic).
Identities left out of the count: library codes and internal standards / carry-over.
Exploratory: no statistical tests, no p-values.
Estimated concentration in water: extract concentration from the external calibration (recommended adduct) / EF 250x * 1000. Shown even when extrapolated.

No correction for SPE recovery (not validated): the true concentration is likely higher. xLOQ_<sample> = sample area / area of the lowest calibration point; < 1 = below it (order of magnitude only). calib_R2 below threshold = unreliable line.
